data.one_liner: Brings a Flutter desktop app window to the front of the OS window stack.
data.what_it_does: The plugin exposes a single static method, WindowToFront.activate(), that moves the current application window to the top of the window stack. It works on Windows, Linux and macOS.
use_when: After returning from an external browser or native authentication flow
When a background process needs to bring the app back into focus
When a modal dialog is closed and the main window should regain focus
avoid_when: On mobile platforms where window focus is managed by the OS
When you need fine‑grained control over window z‑order beyond simply bringing to front
weaknesses: No advanced focus or window‑management options
